title: call.json
description: The Call as the planner settles it: the request in its own words, the kind and how the work reads, the planner's reading of the work's goal and, for a kind new to Turn, of its best practice's, and what a calling AI settled, as given.

kind.description: a short name in lower case, its words joined by -, such as readme or man-page

reading.description: refactor-doc for a document, refactor-code for code

goal.description: who uses the work, and for what, as the request reads; taken where given holds no goal

kind_goal.description: for a kind new to Turn: who uses a work of the kind, and for what

given.description: what the calling AI settled, word for word, as Calling Turn gives it
